system.story: Every machine she owns comes online in one breath - the swarm entire.

effect.after: 7 Uptime, main action. Bring your entire reserve fleet online in one turn - all carried drones deploy free of the usual sustain. Grant the whole fielded fleet a free Rigged Fire or a reposition. Until the end of the encounter, your fielded-fleet Uptime drip is doubled and Overheat is suppressed.
